seo.title: November in the Sea of Cortez with Sergio Torres — Eagle Ray Expeditions
seo.description: Spearfishing, freediving and days at sea with your own people. Private boat, 3 to 7 nights, ending Sunday, November 29.

tagline: The Sea of Cortez isn't visited. It's sailed.

hero.title: November in the Sea of Cortez, with Sergio Torres.
hero.lede: Spearfishing, freediving and days at sea with your own people. Private boat, 3 to 7 nights, ending Sunday, November 29.
hero.imageAlt: Sergio Torres Expedition Leader de Eagle Ray Expeditions Sailing Experience in La Paz

intro.closing: There is a plan, but it is not set in stone.

story.title: From first light to the last star.

scenes.title: Coffee on a flat bay
scenes.body: The boat is still. Sergio leads breathwork and a slow stretch on deck before anyone has said a word.

scenes.title: Into the water
scenes.body: Breath-hold training and freediving, at your own depth and at your own pace.

scenes.title: Fish with Sergio
scenes.body: Spearfishing where it is permitted, then back aboard for a long lunch prepared by the chef.

scenes.title: Nothing on a clock
scenes.body: Swim, read, sleep, or sail on to the next cove. The route follows the weather and your group.

scenes.title: The island turns amber
scenes.body: The anchor drops. The morning's catch goes on the grill.

scenes.title: Dinner at anchor
scenes.body: Stars, stories, and a plan for tomorrow that might change by breakfast.

sergio.title: Sergio Torres, “Canei”.
sergio.intro: He has guided groups in several countries and is now an Expedition Leader at Eagle Ray. On this trip, he shapes the day: when to get in the water, where to fish, and when to do nothing at all.
sergio.quote: The plan adapts to you, not the other way around.

photos.alt: Sergio Torres scusadiving in La paz

activities.title: Scuba diving and sea lions at Los Islotes
activities.body: Dive with the sea lion colony, with certified guides.

crew.title: Sergio takes care of you. The Eagle Ray crew takes care of the boat and the sea.
crew.body: A private boat, a professional crew and a flexible route, shaped around your group.
